description: VAREX SF 2823-14 extraction contract for insured details, beneficiaries, allocation percentages, and the insured or assignee statement.
instructions: Extract only values explicitly stated in the SF 2823 designation of beneficiary form. Do not infer, calculate, reconcile, or populate a missing value. Extract every populated beneficiary row as a separate item in document order. Preserve names, identifiers, dates, addresses, relationships, and numeric percentages exactly as stated. Return null when the source does not state a scalar value and an empty array when it states no beneficiary rows.

insured_name.description: Name of the insured person exactly as stated.

insured_date_of_birth.description: Date of birth of the insured exactly as stated.

insured_ssn.description: Social Security Number of the insured exactly as stated.

insured_claim_number.description: CSA, CSI, or OWCP claim number represented as a number in the VAREX benchmark.

insured_department.description: Department or agency where the insured works.

insured_bureau.description: Bureau or division of the insured's department.

insured_location.description: City, state, and ZIP code location of the insured's department.

total_percentage.description: Total percentage designated for all beneficiaries.

beneficiaries.description: Every populated beneficiary row in document order.

relationship.description: Relationship of the beneficiary to the insured.

percentage.description: Percentage of benefits designated for the beneficiary.

insured_assignee.description: Statement and signature details for the insured or assignee.

name.description: Name of the insured or assignee signing the statement.

address.description: Address of the insured or assignee.

date.description: Date of signature of the insured or assignee.

document_rules.description: Check that insured identity, beneficiary details, the stated allocation total, and the signer statement are present.
Require the stated total beneficiary allocation to equal 100 percent.
Check that the beneficiary percentages add to the stated total percentage.
